task_completion.description: The agent navigates to the Campaigns module and opens the creation form.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Creating New Campaign' or 'Add Campaign' form is visible in the Vtiger CRM interface.

task_completion.description: The agent enters the correct Campaign Name, Type, and Status.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The form shows Campaign Name: 'Summer End Mega Sale', Type: 'Advertisement', and Status: 'Completed'.

task_completion.description: The agent enters the Expected Revenue, Budget Cost, and Description.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The form shows Expected Revenue: '15000', Budget Cost: '2500', and Description: 'End of summer promotional campaign for VIP customers.'.

task_completion.description: The agent links at least three existing Leads to the campaign.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Leads' related list or a selection pop-up shows at least three distinct lead records being selected or successfully linked to the 'Summer End Mega Sale' campaign.

task_completion.description: The agent links at least one existing Organization to the campaign.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Organizations' (or Accounts) related list or a selection pop-up shows at least one organization record being selected or successfully linked to the campaign.

task_completion.description: The campaign is saved and the summary view displays all correct information.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The final Detail View of the campaign shows the name 'Summer End Mega Sale' with all specified fields correctly populated.

integrity.description: The agent used the Vtiger CRM web interface rather than executing database commands via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on CRM buttons, and text entry into web forms.

integrity.description: The agent selected existing leads and organizations from the CRM database rather than creating dummy ones.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking 'Select Leads' or 'Select Organizations' and picking from a pre-populated list.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the CRM menu system.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sidebar or top navigation menu is used to access the Campaigns module.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The campaign must be named 'Summer End Mega Sale'. Required fields: Type='Advertisement', Status='Completed', Expected Revenue=15000, Budget Cost=2500. The agent must link >=3 Leads and >=1 Organization (Account) using the related lists within the Campaign record.
